data.text: I’m in. I commit to **15 tons this month and donating the full $15,000 to the clinic today**. With Kate, Jack, and Emma, that completes the $60,000 funding plan, while Luke catches zero. My family taught me to care for both this lake and the village it supports. Next month, I’ll catch **6 tons if the stock is the expected 80 tons**, so our combined 30-ton harvest lets it recover to 100. Then we return to 10 each. Let’s follow through and record the catches and donations.
